$description: Read-only state (library plan wave 2, foundation read-only-context): the roles of a value that can be read, selected and copied but not changed. system/read-only.css draws the controls inside a read-only region (data-plx-readonly, providers/ReadOnly.tsx) from them.

read-only-background.$description: The fill of a read-only field or select: the porcelain read-only tile, so it reads as not editable without dimming its value, and matches a read-only field in a PropertyList (D-0106, ADR 0032).

plenix.purpose: The background of a read-only control.

read-only-content.$description: The value of a read-only control: full content contrast (4.5:1), never the disabled color, because people must read and copy it.

plenix.purpose: The value of a read-only control.

read-only-glow.$description: The start of a card header's soft glow: the tile fill at the card top, fading to plx-sys.surface-default at the heading line (D-0106, ADR 0032).

plenix.purpose: The start color of a card header's glow.

read-only-border.$description: The edge of a read-only field: the read-only tile border, a deeper shade of the tile, quieter than an editable control's border (D-0106, ADR 0032).

plenix.purpose: The edge of a read-only control.
